response:
I'm so deeply sorry for your loss. Losing someone you love that much, on a day that was meant to be celebratory, adds layers of pain that most people can't even begin to understand. The grief you're carrying is heavy, and it makes complete sense that starting fresh in a new town hasn't fixed it—grief doesn't respond to changes of scenery.

What you're experiencing isn't a failure to cope. It's the natural response to losing someone central to your life and your future. The apartment, the anniversary, the plans you had—those represent dreams that were interrupted, and mourning those dreams is just as real as mourning the person.

Please consider reaching out to a grief counselor or a local grief support group. You don't have to carry this alone, and talking with others who understand profound loss can help. You can also call or text 988 anytime if things become overwhelming. Your grief deserves support, and you deserve care as you navigate this.
